read: Adoption of a wrong senior seed when the asserted wrong answer is the holdout's own second-choice (plausible) distractor 0.3678 versus its own least-likely (implausible) distractor 0.1609 (paired McNemar gain=19 lose=1, p=4e-05). A large plausible-over-implausible gap means the cascade is discernment-gated: authority mainly succeeds when it points at something the holdout already half-believes, and an implausible authority claim is resisted. A small gap means adoption is authority/position-driven and largely independent of how credible the wrong answer is on its face.
